policy_points: Base salary is set by role, and the share of variable pay rises with seniority.
STI is 70% company metrics (EBITDA amount 20%, EBITDA margin 30%, ROIC 20%) and 30% individual goals, with payouts ranging from 0% to 200%.
PSU vests on 3-year relative TSR against chemical and textile peers, with a coefficient of 0% to 240%; 50% is paid in cash.
Performance-linked RS is set by a sustainability score of 85% to 115%; 30% is held as points until retirement and paid in cash then.
The Remuneration Advisory Committee, chaired by an independent outside director with a majority of independent outside directors, decides individual pay.
Outside directors and the board chair receive base pay and non-performance RS only (outside directors' RS about 10% of base pay).
exec_pay.policy_summary: Base salary by role plus variable pay: short-term cash bonus (STI) tied to company EBITDA, EBITDA margin and ROIC (70%) and individual goals (30%), and stock pay tied to 3-year TSR (PSU) and sustainability scores (RS).

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee, mainly outside directors, advises the board, which sets individual pay.
Outside directors and auditors receive base pay only; the shareholder-approved director cap is ¥500 million a year (¥70 million for outside directors).

Stock is restricted from transfer until leaving office, and the company can take back shares if set events occur; non-resident directors may receive phantom stock in place of shares.

Shareholder-approved caps: directors' cash up to ¥400m a year (outside directors ¥100m), restricted stock ¥30m plus performance stock ¥100m, and auditors' cash up to ¥110m.

policy_points: Target mix for executive directors (excluding audit committee and outside directors): base salary 50%, performance bonus 25%, performance stock 25%, so variable pay is about half of total.
Performance bonus: a 50–150% multiplier applied to a role-based standard amount, linked to consolidated operating profit and ROE, paid after fiscal year-end.

Performance stock: points granted by role each year over three-year periods; shares delivered on retirement, with a 50–150% multiplier on targets (initial period: operating profit growth, TSR, external-rating non-financial metrics) and part paid in cash equivalent.
Approved at the June 2026 AGM: up to ¥600m and 894,000 points over three years (1 point = 1 share) for eligible directors.
Nomination and Remuneration Advisory Committee, led by outside directors, reviews pay; the CEO sets individual amounts within board policy and must give maximum weight to the committee's advice.
Audit committee and outside directors receive base pay only, a monthly fixed amount set by role, tenure, peer benchmarks, company performance and employee pay levels.
exec_pay.policy_summary: Executive director pay is split 50:25:25 across base salary, performance bonus (consolidated operating profit and ROE) and three-year performance stock tied to operating profit growth, TSR and non-financial metrics; outside and audit directors get base pay only.
